title: Supply Chain Attack on io.github.leetcrunch:scribejava-core
technical_mechanism: obfuscated OAuth-harvesting code triggers only on the 15th of each month
summary: A malicious package 'io.github.leetcrunch:scribejava-core' was discovered in the Maven ecosystem. The attack involved time-triggered OAuth credential theft. Mechanism: obfuscated OAuth-harvesting code triggers only on the 15th of each month
